hook: NVIDIA is acquiring Hugging Face for almost $13 billion!
body: This massive move brings the dominant AI hardware provider together with the home for open-source AI models and tools. The goal: scale Hugging Face's platform, improve infrastructure, and broaden AI access globally. Developers can expect enhanced tools and wider reach for their AI projects, backed by NVIDIA's resources. It's a game-changer for the open-source AI ecosystem.
